name: smwsprites-switch-controlled-grey-rotating-platform
title: Switch-Controlled Grey Rotating Platform
description:
A recode of the grey rotating platform (sprite A3) with a lot of new behavior based on a switch, including:
- Ability to control with an ON/OFF switch, or a custom one.
- Ability to switch rotation direction, or to start frozen and then rotate after state change.

Now PIXI compatible.
